quote: You spend your days waiting for storms to clear. You build walls against pain that never arrives. You carry heavy burdens nobody asked you to hold. You fear the dark while hiding from your light. The cage was unlocked the entire time you suffered. You were always the warden of your own prison. Freedom begins the moment you finally decide to leave.
